title: xo agent attachment — one backend's agent record for a project
description:
Optional and adapter-owned. Present in a project when a project-tied backend has attached an agent to it; the file EXISTING is the signal (the sidebar's `list_agents` keys on existence and tolerates a record it cannot parse), so the contents are advisory rather than structural. Written by exactly one backend per record — the one named in `backend` — through that adapter's `_write`, atomically; no core module writes this file. The document is deliberately OPEN (`additionalProperties: true`): it belongs to whichever adapter created it, and an adapter must be able to carry its own fields without an edit to this core schema. docs/syncplan.md §5.4.

NOTHING is required. Every reader keys on the project's DIRECTORY NAME, never on a field of this document — `get_detail` falls back to the directory name for every display value — and records written before the `backend` tag existed are still on disk. Requiring a key the readers do not need would only strand data this schema cannot help.

$schema.description: Editor hint — this schema's `$id`, not a filesystem path. Stamped on records minted after this schema existed; absent on older ones.

schema.description: Record schema version. Absent on every record written before this schema existed, and an absent version means 1: no writer back-fills it, because rewriting an old record purely to stamp a version is a write with no reader behind it.

id.description: Project directory name at creation time. Informational only — every consumer keys on the actual directory name, which this may have drifted from after a rename.

name.description: Human-readable display name the user typed. Readers fall back to the directory name when this is absent or empty.

description.description: One-line summary the user typed; the empty string when the creator supplied none.

backend.description: The adapter name of whichever backend owns this record. An OPEN STRING, never an enumeration: enumerating the known backends here would put backend names in a core file (which this repo forbids outside `adapters/<name>/`, `config/agents/<name>/` and `config/models/<name>/`) and would mean a new backend could not represent its own record without a core schema edit. Absent, null or the empty string means UNTAGGED — such a record predates the tag, and by the deliberate carve-out in docs/syncplan.md §6 T5 it stays claimable by every project-tied adapter, so ownership filtering narrows first-adapter-wins for tagged data without stranding what is already on disk.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of record creation.
